overview.description: The Grayscale XRP Trust ETF (GXRP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long xrp, short usd currency. The fund is passively managed, offering exposure to the daily USD spot price of XRP (XRP). An investment in the fund is not a direct investment in XRP. GXRP was launched on Sep 5, 2024 and is issued by Grayscale.
